conclusion: S0–S3 already use the original additive nonholonomic potential and the positive phase sign in the supplied controller. A new learned-perception experiment is not needed merely to update the visualization.

scientific_interface.field_access: Independent scalar signal at the true plant position; only geometry and switching use the estimated position. No field gradient is supplied to the oscillatory control.
scientific_interface.reference: A source-aligned reference direction is specified a priori per configuration.
scientific_interface.scaling: physical position [m] = L * position [workspace units], L=0.5; t_seconds=T*tau, T=80.
scientific_interface.heading: heading0 + 2*pi*sqrt(omega)*t_seconds/T; recover from the controller clock, never from the path tangent.
scientific_interface.no_shift: The selected records use field_offset=0 and directly apply the original additive potential; no extra J-star phase shift is inserted.
scientific_interface.arrival: 0.125 m source neighborhood held for 8 s, horizon 3200 s; preserve original terminal samples.

cohort_source.verification: All website cohort counts, frame-weighted costs, request fractions and minimum clearances recalculated from per-run result JSON. Raw trace/frame hashes below cover the 15 selected video runs.

limitations: No new controller mission or learned perception inference was run. The short ABI steps above only verify formula/interface consistency.
The 0.2 s trajectory logs undersample the 20 Hz input carrier. The 0.02 s perception logs contain more position samples but do not certify resolution of every state-dependent oscillation.
At 32x playback, high-frequency motion cannot be temporally resolved in a conventional video. Do not enlarge or synthesize oscillations in a recording.
All selected switches occur at t=0; the first stored trajectory sample is post-jump. Later constant q is expected, not an implementation failure.

The frame q field is captured for perception routing before the image correction triggers supervision. At t=0 it may retain the pre-jump mode while the trajectory sample is post-jump. For synchronized control display, start with config.initial_mode and apply recorded events through the selected sample time; keep any initial pre-jump hold explicitly paused.

For denser replay, use true/estimated positions at frame.capture_s, compute heading at that same capture_s, and preserve the final trajectory record when the run completes. Cumulative full-frame use is the number of expert==1 rows divided by the number of elapsed frame rows.

The interactive browser illustration uses the same law family with different gains, time/length scales, exact-position feedback and a relaxed first-entry stop. Its trajectory and metrics are not these frozen CAP experiments.
Rendered ground, drone and vehicle appearances are presentation assets, not the original network input frames or Isaac Sim experimental evidence.
Accounted perception cost is a fixed executed-module reference cost plus measured routing overhead; it excludes rendering and is not end-to-end wall-clock latency.
This audit verifies recorded provenance, algebra and numerical interface consistency; it is not a proof of stability or a fresh validation of the trained perception network.
